info.title: testwire
info.description: Generates xUnit/NUnit test stubs for ASP.NET Core controllers using Roslyn. Reads your actual controller structure and produces compilable test files with mocked dependencies.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: TestWire - Auto-generate integration test stubs for ASP.NET Core controllers

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Scan a .csproj and generate test stubs

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the .csproj file to analyze

options.name: --framework
options.description: Test framework to use: xunit or nunit

options.name: --output
options.description: File or directory path for generated test files

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print output to console without writing files
